title: Minimax-Optimal Small-Loss Regret in Online Convex Optimization and Applications to Contextual Search and Online Inverse Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.27572v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We give small-loss regret bounds for online convex optimization (OCO), using one subgradient per round. Let $\Delta_T^\star$ denote the cumulative loss of the best fixed decision in hindsight, measured relative to the per-round minima. Our algorithm achieves the regret bound $O(1+\sqrt{\Delta_T^\star})$ without knowing $\Delta_T^\star$, up to domain and gradient-scale factors. The bound is minimax optimal, including its domain dependence, on $\ell_p$ balls for every $1\le p\le\infty$. No smoothness or condition bounding gradient norms by loss values is assumed, and neither loss values nor the time horizon are needed. Algorithmically, we extend the metric-update revocation of Gupta et al. (2026), originally developed for online inverse optimization, to general OCO using the follow-the-regularized-leader framework and a mixture of multiple base learners. We also apply our algorithm to contextual search and online inverse optimization. In $

translated_title: 在线凸优化中的极小极大最优小损失遗憾及其在上下文搜索与在线逆优化中的应用
translated_abstract: 我们为在线凸优化（OCO）给出了小损失遗憾界，每轮仅需使用一个次梯度。设 $\Delta_T^\star$ 表示事后最优固定决策相对于每轮最小值度量的累积损失。我们的算法在不知道 $\Delta_T^\star$ 的情况下即可达到 $O(1+\sqrt{\Delta_T^\star})$ 的遗憾界（最多相差定义域与梯度尺度因子）。该遗憾界是极小极大最优的，包括其对定义域的依赖性，对所有 $1\le p\le\infty$ 的 $\ell_p$ 球均成立。我们既不假设平滑性，也不假设梯度范数受损失值约束的条件，且既不需要损失值，也不需要时间范围。在算法层面，我们通过遵循正则化领导者（follow-the-regularized-leader）框架和多个基础学习器的混合，将 Gupta 等人（2026）最初为在线逆优化开发的度量更新撤销技术扩展到一般 OCO。我们还将该算法应用于上下文搜索和在线逆优化。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个在线凸优化算法，在每轮仅需一个次梯度、不知道损失值和时间范围、无平滑性假设的条件下，实现了极小极大最优的 $O(1+\sqrt{\Delta_T^\star})$ 小损失遗憾界，并成功应用于上下文搜索和在线逆优化问题。
en_tdlr: This paper achieves minimax-optimal small-loss regret $O(1+\sqrt{\Delta_T^\star})$ for online convex optimization using only one subgradient per round, without knowing losses, the time horizon, or any smoothness assumptions, with applications to contextual search and online inverse optimization.
